description: Read the comment thread on a recording: top-level comments with the moment they point at (timestampMs), replies (parentCommentId), and resolved state. Use it to see what reviewers flagged. Author names only. Needs comments:read.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.
